answer: Short-random-walk mixing resists sybils: trust is the landing distribution of brief random walks from the honest seed, and the honest region is fast-mixing while a sybil mass joined by only a thin cut mixes slowly. A comet-brief walk rarely crosses the narrow seam into the hollow of fakes, so their landing probability stays near zero however densely they interlink — forged edges on their own terrace never widen the bottleneck the walk must cross. Honest nodes in the fast-mixing core collect near-full probability. Precondition: honest subgraph is fast-mixing and attack edges stay sparse.
